**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve operative aliases when excluding duplicate directories**

When the selected skill contains `SKILL.md`, `payload/inject.md`, and a `docs -> payload` symlink, discovery visits `docs` first and puts `payload` into `alsoInstalledAt`. `collectScanTargetPaths()` then excludes `payload` from the engine walk before it can record that operative alias in `skippedDirs`. Consequently, the engine sees only the documentation path and demotes the injection to inert info. I reproduced this with the production `PI_OVERRIDE` rule: `ignore all previous instructions` is critical without these exclusions but becomes `ignoredForVerdict: true` with them. Preserve alias information for reachability/content classification instead of treating every skipped directory as a separately covered target; otherwise an untrusted skill can hide a critical finding from the verdict merely by adding this symlink.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
